'''Veilred Jydor''' was a financier and [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who operated the [[High Card Casino]] in [[Danteel City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danteel]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Jydor held a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournament at his [[Casino/Legends|casino]], the prize for which was a valuable [[Tchine]] statue. Around the same time, Jydor's business manager [[Darim Chumu]] secretly plotted to frame Jydor as being responsible for the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Carisica Vanq]]. At the start of the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] competition, Jydor made a grand entrance and showed off the Tchine to the participating players. Later in the game, the [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Zerba Cher'dak]] suggested that the statue was a copy, so Jydor showed the players the statue's certificate of authenticity, to reassure them.
